en: Tinted historic postcard showing two long, attached institutional buildings with high, sloped roofs and dormer windows. Leafless trees stand in front, and a very large group of children and adults, likely orphans and staff, pose in the courtyard. The architecture is plain, 19th‑century Northern European. At the bottom, red printed Dutch text labels the scene as buildings of an orphanage in Neerbosch.
